temporal_window_meta.description: Window duration, length, and effective sampling rate used to normalize motion features.

quality_visibility.description: Observed-row, frame completeness, bbox-valid, hidden, visible, and feature-valid ratios used as masks/quality covariates.
quality_visibility.prediction_time_available: deployment-dependent for annotation Hidden; use only if runtime can produce equivalent flags

motion_kinematics.description: Speed, acceleration, path length, direction change, displacement, burstiness, and motion energy from one object track within a window.

geometry_shape.description: Scale/aspect-ratio variability proxies from bbox geometry. They describe pose/shape but are not labels.

social_context.description: Nearest-neighbor distance, pair overlap/contact, social density, approach/separation, and aggression proxy from same-frame group geometry.
social_context.leakage_risk: low-to-medium; verify no behavior label is used to choose partners

bbox_xywh_n.description: Per-frame normalized actor bbox x/y/width/height sequence.

motion_delta.description: Per-frame actor motion delta sequence; must be grouped within object track/window only.

roi_class_relation.description: Class-specific feeder/drinker/toy ROI relation sequence; model-usable because it is not target-label-selected.

social_relation.description: Per-frame label-independent social relation features from same-frame neighbors.

length_mask.description: Window-length mask for padded sequence positions.

observed_mask.description: Observed-frame mask; missing frames stay masked instead of dropped.

frame_index_sequence.description: Frame indices for audit/alignment; do not feed to model unless a trainer explicitly treats it as positional metadata.

notes: Current tabular X has no ROI columns; ROI context is present in spatial NPZ as roi_class_relation.
Do not use target_roi_* or label-selected ROI fields as model X.
Hidden/visibility fields require deployment-time availability audit before final training claims.
